note.question: What are the best contracts to be used in supply chains exposed to fluctuating raw material costs?
note.overview: Problem description: Purchase costs of raw materials required in production tend to fluctuate over time. Mild cost fluctuations merely affect firms’ profitability. Significant variations can lead to supply chain disruption.
